root_cause: The cleanup guard for D8Console-specific teardown (skip when inspector enabled) was placed before the unconditional map-erase operation that must always run to keep the isolate-keyed profiler_end_callback_ map in sync with isolate lifetime, causing the erase to be conditionally skipped and leaving dangling references to a disposed Isolate.
findings: Shell::ResetOnProfileEndListener(Isolate*) is responsible for tearing down the per-isolate profiler-end callback state before an Isolate is disposed. The function was modified to add an early 'if (options.enable_inspector) return;' guard BEFORE the call to profiler_end_callback_.erase(isolate).
